summary: Repeal the NFA Act This bill repeals the National Firearms Act (NFA), as codified and amended in Chapter 53 of the Internal Revenue Code. Among other requirements, the NFA requires the registration of certain firearms, including short-barreled shotguns and rifles, machine guns, silencers, destructive devices (e.g., bombs, grenades, and rockets), and other specified weapons; requires the registration of the manufacturers, dealers, and importers of such items; imposes taxes on the making and transfer of such items; imposes an occupational tax on the manufacturers, dealers, and importers of such items; requires background checks for prospective purchasers of such items; and imposes penalties for violations of the requirements imposed by the NFA.
